edit.description: `pendingGate`'s declaration and return type, and the two touched-path helpers' context parameter
the batched-merge section's sentence on which builtins withhold the declaration, and the builtin roster beside it
the gate over a batch context, and its claim check over the spans' union
the width a phase hanging the queue gate at afterMerge reaches

summary: `pendingGate` declares it reads a batch, so hanging it at `afterMerge` no longer holds a phase to one span per merge
acceptance: `pendingGate` returns a gate declaring `batches: true` and runs over a batch context — the queue read at the batch's last pick, the claim check over the spans' touched-path union — so a phase whose only `afterMerge` gate it is reaches the chain's declared `mergeBatch` width; `docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md` no longer states that it judges the gated commit as one span's
tests: the queue gate validates the queue at a batch's last pick
the queue gate refuses a batch whose spans touched an entry another tick holds a claim on
a phase whose only afterMerge gate is the queue gate reaches the declared merge width
pins: a phase whose afterMerge gates include chainLoadGate still merges one span at a time

interface.changes: `pendingGate` returns a `BatchingGate`: a chain may hang it at `afterMerge` on a batching phase and keep the width it declared
interface.hides: which of the gate's reads would have been per-span — the gated commit and the touched-path union are the same two facts under either context, so a chain places the claim check where it bites without reasoning about merge width
interface.rejected: a consumer-side wrapper spreading the gate and declaring `batches: true` on the copy — the declaration is a claim about `run`, which only the gate's own module can honestly make

notes: Build note, 2026-10-07; re-verified on this tip: the gate reads `readGatedQueue(ctx)` at `ctx.commitSha` plus `ctx.touchedPaths`, `ctx.stateRootRel` and `ctx.repoRoot`, every one of them on `BatchGateContext` (`src/Gate.ts:272`), and nothing a batch withholds. `docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md:1035` states the opposite reason. This repo hangs the `afterMerge` copy on singleton producers only, so no phase here changes width.
